title: Establish payment and purchasing approval controls
summary: Before delegating spending or as payment volume and fraud exposure increase. A tested authorization matrix with independently verified payee changes and auditable payment evidence.
outcomes: A tested authorization matrix with independently verified payee changes and auditable payment evidence.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before delegating spending or as payment volume and fraud exposure increase.

parts.title: Map spending and payment risks
parts.guidance: List purchasing channels, payment accounts, cards, payee-maintenance rights and who currently requests, approves, releases and reconciles payments. Identify cases where one person controls the entire transaction.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve the control design
parts.guidance: Finance leadership sets authority limits, segregation of duties and exception rules suited to team size. Specify independent verification for new or changed bank details and the escalation path for urgent requests.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Configure approved access and approval rules
parts.guidance: The account administrator implements the approved roles and limits in purchasing and banking systems. Use least-privilege access, retain configuration evidence and protect recovery access from the same person who releases payments.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the reviewed account operation described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Configure approved access and approval rules

parts.title: Test normal and exception transactions
parts.guidance: Walk a small authorized test through request, approval, release and reconciliation. Also test a changed-payee and unavailable-approver scenario without sending funds to an unverified account.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Monitor exceptions and reconcile evidence
parts.guidance: Match released payments to approved invoices and statements. Review overrides and access periodically, record discrepancies and require a new approval for changes outside the original scope.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: A tested authorization matrix with independently verified payee changes and auditable payment evidence.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
